title: Map Builder zoom re-raster (fix blur)
description:
Zooming in on Map Building still looked blurry because sheet bitmaps were not reliably re-rasterized at the new scale. The paint floor also ignored the ~2.8× map layout scale, so backing stores stayed too small. Failed paints could swap in a native PDF iframe that never re-renders on zoom.

Map zoom now debounces, clears stale quality tiers, re-paints visible sheets at full DPI with a layout-scale-aware screen-pixel floor, and keeps the previous canvas if a paint fails instead of falling back to a soft iframe.

Who is affected: PipeSync Map Building on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh PipeSync. After zooming, wait a short beat for sheets to sharpen.
changeLog: Force Map Builder sheet re-raster on zoom at full DPI.
Include map layout display scale in the on-screen bitmap floor.
Debounce zoom repaint so the final zoom gets a sharp pass.
Do not replace failed canvas paints with native iframes that stay blurry.
